dialog.title: Account status

field.untilHint: Required: a suspension without an end date is a block that dares not say its name.
field.reasonHint: This is what the person will read when they find the door closed. Write it for them.
field.revokeSessionsHint: Otherwise the person stays signed in until their token expires.

help.active: Access is restored immediately; the previous reason is cleared.
help.suspended: Access restricted until a date. Data is kept.
help.blocked: Lasting exclusion, with no end date. Data is kept.

dialog.lockedNotice: One of this person's accounts is locked after failed attempts. That lock expires on its own and is not a suspension.

error.missing_deadline: A suspension must carry an end date.
